Reference guide

Guides & Assumptions

These calculators separate vanilla Minecraft conversions from server-specific farm estimates. Use the results as planning tools and test uncertain rates on your actual server.

01

Bones and bone meal

In Minecraft, one bone crafts into three bone meal, and one bone block crafts into nine bone meal. The Kelp Calculator assumes one bone meal grows one kelp for a planning estimate; real production can be affected by farm mechanics and server configuration.

02

Fuel and smokers

A blaze rod smelts 12 items; charcoal smelts 8. The calculator follows a smoker throughput of one dried kelp item every 5 seconds per smoker, or 12 items per minute.

03

Dried-kelp blocks

Nine dried kelp craft into one dried-kelp block. The calculator counts only complete blocks for block revenue and reports leftover dried kelp separately. A shulker box holds 27 stacks; at 64 items per stack, that is 1,728 items.

04

Sea-pickle yield

Sea-pickle output from bone meal depends on the farm method and environment. The default of 2.4 pickles per bone meal is a Donut SMP estimate, not a guaranteed vanilla recipe. Use Custom Yield to match your own test results.

05

Profit versus revenue

Revenue is the estimated selling value. Total profit subtracts the input costs included in the calculator. The Kelp Calculator counts the price of all fuel entered, even if some fuel capacity is unused, because it treats that amount as purchased inventory.

06

Check official references

For vanilla recipes and mechanics, consult the official Minecraft dried-kelp article and the Minecraft Wiki. For comparison with server-specific yield conventions, see the DonutSMPTools Bones-to-Kelp calculator and Sea Pickle calculator. Always verify market prices and server settings in-game.

SmpFarmingTools provides estimates and is not an official Minecraft product.
Project information

About SmpFarmingTools

A community-made project for practical farming calculations, cost checks, and planning on Minecraft SMP servers.

About the project

SmpFarmingTools turns farm inputs and market prices into clear estimates for output, storage, revenue, profit, and processing time. The goal is to make repeated calculations easier without hiding important assumptions.
